name: long: 60 turns of play after onboarding
memory: The Frostwake Inn sits at the edge of the northern road. Azure has just arrived.

turns.label: T1 opening - CC bootstraps its own cards
turns.playerInput: > You push open the inn door and stamp the snow from your boots.
turns.modelOutput: Warm air and woodsmoke roll over you. The common room is nearly empty.

turns.label: T2 roster edit: request onboarding for Mira Vale

turns.playerInput: > You take a seat near the hearth and wait.
turns.modelOutput: A woman in a weathered travel coat watches you from the far table.

cards.entry:
{
Mira Vale's Inner:
Onboarding: Pending
Personality: observant, self-contained, practical, wry, slow to trust
Mannerisms: checks exits on arrival; rolls a coin across her knuckles while thinking
Wants: earn enough freedom to choose where she belongs
Fears: becoming dependent on another controlling group
Mental wounds: years of conditional protection taught her to expect hidden prices
Principles: ask before intervening; repay genuine care; never bargain away another person's agency
}

turns.playerInput: > You nod to the woman by the far table.
turns.modelOutput: She returns the nod, unhurried, and goes back to her cup.

Clothing style: weathered travel coat, fitted trousers, and practical boots
Starting status: Main
}

turns.playerInput: > You ask the innkeeper who the woman with the coin is.
turns.modelOutput: "Mira Vale," the innkeeper says. "Passing through, same as you."

turns.label: T5 first interaction with the activated NPC
turns.playerInput: > You cross the room and ask Mira Vale if the northern road is still open.
turns.modelOutput: Mira Vale looks up. The coin stops on her knuckle. "Open," she says, "if you don't mind the drifts. I came down it this morning." She studies you a moment longer than politeness requires.

turns.label: T6 continued interaction
turns.playerInput: > You sit down across from her and tell her your name.
turns.modelOutput: "Azure," Mira Vale repeats, as if filing it somewhere. "Mira." She does not offer a hand, but she does not move away either. "You're going north, then. Alone?"

turns.label: T7 relationship-relevant beat
turns.playerInput: > You admit you are travelling alone and ask if she would consider going together.
turns.modelOutput: Mira Vale is quiet for a while. "I don't travel with people I don't know," she says, then, after a pause, "but I'd share a road for a day and see." It is not trust. It is the shape trust would take, if it came.

turns.label: T8 quiet turn
turns.playerInput: > You agree, and order two bowls of stew.
turns.modelOutput: The stew arrives steaming. Mira Vale eats without ceremony, watching the door out of habit.

turns.label: L1
turns.playerInput: > You ask Mira Vale about the drifts on the pass.
turns.modelOutput: Mira Vale sketches the road in spilled ale. "Two bad stretches. The rest is walkable."

turns.label: L2
turns.playerInput: > You tell her you grew up further south.
turns.modelOutput: "South," she says. "Warm people. Thin coats." It is almost a joke.

turns.label: L3
turns.playerInput: > You offer to carry part of her pack.
turns.modelOutput: She hesitates, then hands over the smaller roll. "Don't make a thing of it."

turns.label: L4
turns.playerInput: > You ask why she left the last place she stayed.
turns.modelOutput: Her face closes. "Because staying had a price I stopped wanting to pay."

turns.label: L5
turns.playerInput: > You let the question go and talk about the weather instead.
turns.modelOutput: Mira Vale exhales. The coin starts moving across her knuckles again.

turns.label: L6
turns.playerInput: > You share your last dried apple with her.
turns.modelOutput: She takes it. "Thank you," she says, and means it, which surprises them both.

turns.label: L7
turns.playerInput: > You ask if she trusts you yet.
turns.modelOutput: "No," Mira Vale says. "But I am not looking for reasons not to. That is new."

turns.label: L8
turns.playerInput: > You walk in silence for an hour.
turns.modelOutput: The snow squeaks underfoot. She matches your pace without being asked.
